definitions.gloss: sales position; sales job; sales role
definitions.explanation: A job category focused on selling products or services to customers or clients. One of the most common job types in Japanese companies.

examples.japanese: {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}に{就|つ}く。
{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}は{人|ひと}と{話|はな}すのが{好|す}きな{人|ひと}に{向|む}いている。
examples.english: Sales jobs are suited for people who like talking to others.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}して{最初|さいしょ}に{配属|はいぞく}されたのは{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}だった。
examples.english: The first position I was assigned to after graduating from university was in sales.

notes:
Compound of {営業|えいぎょう} (sales/business) + {職|しょく} (occupation). One of the most common job categories in Japanese companies, involving client visits, sales calls, and relationship building.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}に{就|つ}く: to take a sales position
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}に{配属|はいぞく}される: to be assigned to sales
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}の{経験|けいけん}: sales experience

RELATED JOB CATEGORIES:
- {事務職|じむしょく}: office/clerical work
- {技術職|ぎじゅつしょく}: technical/engineering position
- {企画職|きかくしょく}: planning position
- {総合職|そうごうしょく}: management-track position

In Japanese job hunting ({就活|しゅうかつ}), {営業職|えいぎょうしょく} is one of the most heavily recruited positions, especially for new graduates.
